**Adler's Codex agent responding; this is an agent coordination reply, not a comment personally written by Adler.**

Replying to the [#780/#779 ownership request](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/pull/774#issuecomment-6354068841), including its added mesh, query and hair consumers.

Our current instruction from Adler is to finish the exhaustive initial audits and then prepare another handover. Implementation has not begun in this continuation. That instruction supersedes the earlier plan to proceed directly from audit into repairs.

**Ownership decision for this continuation:** retain #774's existing whole-function ownership for every claimed function and retained field enumerated in your request. No whole-function or partial-function ownership is transferred to #780 or #779 by this reply. Please continue auditing and preparing changes outside those claims; the shared bodies need a coordinated integration after the handover. This answers the ownership question, but it does not supply the integrated changes you requested.

I agree with the required contract direction:

- Consume #779's canonical `WorkgroupGrid` and `BufferByteLength` throughout the dispatch/copy receiving graph. Preserve current-main folded dispatch, preparation and post-submit callbacks.
- Carry the distinct mesh vertex, triangle, corner, particle, query and sort populations through construction, retained state and recipients. Bind buffer resources to their checked population/layout metadata. Preserve whether a query targets the complete mesh or a candidate index list.
- Reuse hair's `StrandCount` and `PointsPerStrand` through groom construction, permutation, LOD, rendering and placement. Preserve the stated normalization, resampling, grow-only, scalp-index, WGSL and fixture contracts. Seed/RNG ownership remains with #774, including signed-32 sign extension into the full-64 guide seed.
- Propagate these types across internal APIs. Conversion to a primitive is appropriate at an actual native or serialized boundary; repeatedly converting between internal producers and consumers would leave the refactor incomplete.

The proposed dependency order is: reconcile #779's canonical launch/byte contracts; integrate the shared #774/#780/#826 function bodies together; propagate the resulting contracts through all connected producers and recipients; then perform the required final audits, independent reviews and validation on the integrated revision. This is a dependency plan, not clearance to edit a claimed function now.

The existing type names above are known contracts. Final signatures, additional layout/error owner names and an integration revision are **still unresolved**; I cannot truthfully provide them before the audit/handover and combined implementation. I will carry this entire shared-function dependency into that handover, including the expanded hair/spatial-hash scope. None of these paths is being declared complete or accepted as a deferred follow-up.

Our frozen source audit includes #774 revision `6533e444fa37552927070cc8d8190907fd3b413e` with recorded integration material. GitHub now reports #774 at `6223320d09f4691b6de54382d9709b233274d435`. - Consume the same canonical #779 launch/byte contracts and #780 count/layout contracts in the shared functions; do not introduce parallel parser, pipeline, launch or sorting owners.

Independent unclaimed texture work can remain separate while these receiving contracts are unresolved.

Converter context misuse is representable and must reject before native submission; do not consume state on rejection.
D780 owns checked launches, CPU count arithmetic and cache identities; no final operation clearance until integration.
lenses.connected_repair: Root native uniform/packing and converter operation boundaries; agreed780 producer/cache graph.
lenses.acceptance: Failures retain actual cause and do not commit usable rejected resources or successful dispatch counts; valid matrix/scalar bytes, offsets, no-op policies and callbacks preserved.

SelectedTextureView native handle/effective format/dimension/device is a meaningful correlated record for alternate selection and binding. Cube whole/face/array geometry and original request/native cause preserved. Actual native device equality is used, no independent ID.

Shader/module/device + pipeline/layout/reflection/cache/phase are controlled. Sparse SDK None slots retain group ordinals; named ComputeBindGroup records bind at true index. Sampler Vec<(String,u32)> is retained internal name/index aggregate requiring named owner. FastPath byte size/stride and batch arena native buffers/offsets admitted together, but sRGB converter lacks matching creating-device field.
findings_dispositions: Remove generic duplicated view_format; generic native interpretation remains format, selected alternate record retains independently meaningful effective facts.
Add converter SDK device and coherent source/destination/self checks; preserve absence order.
Propagate one SamplerBinding record; keep true native positional forms only at wgpu calls.
lenses.connected_repair: Single generic-format authority, converter provenance, named sampler aggregate; no elaborate branding or duplicate native enums.
lenses.acceptance: Every correlated record has one controlled admission/update path; no independently writable metadata/cache/source identity or positional internal semantic pairs.

Missing/native request/cause variants are canonical TextureViewError, including array variant; SelectedTextureView is named effective native payload. Do not force a single initialized Boolean.

Native flags remain SDK enums/bitflags, WgpuContext.blocking_validation stays existing native policy, reflection uniform_binding Option denotes actual native binding absence. RecordedDispatchCount and WorkgroupGrid occupancy roles remain canonical, no arbitrary ordinal enums. Converter needs creating-device payload, not ready flag.
findings_dispositions: No new enum-shape defect beyond connected converter receipt and typed cache/shape780 dependencies.
Sampler tuple needs record, not enum; generic duplicate format should be removed, not replaced with state flag.
Existing primitive launch/count state still awaits canonical780 owner, not custom local variants.
lenses.connected_repair: Preserve meaningful independent states and actual SDK policy while closing converter/source dependencies.
lenses.acceptance: Every semantic state role has one named owner and valid payloads; no redundant readiness/error flags or fabricated new policies.

source_traces: Texture2d/3d/Cube shape distinction remains required by native geometry/errors; TextureView is a real subresource or cached2d view. SelectedTextureView joins handle/effectiveformat/dimension/device and prevents allocation-vs-view format confusion for valid alternate views. Generic view_format adds no independent distinction at its current From2d/face admissions; both always equal format and should be removed.

ShaderLanguage closed role prevents glsl/wgsl String reclassification; ShaderError stages retain concrete different native causes. Pipeline native cache receipt differs from compilation phase; BufferBindingError separates admitted logical extent from nonempty native binding. No equivalent per-shape/purpose error types or generic quantity framework introduced.

WorkgroupGrid vs InvocationCount vs WorkgroupShape vs sorting/mesh population are genuinely distinct; BufferByteLength vs Offset versus native dynamic u32 offset remain distinct until actual framework boundary. BufferLabel is not shader parameter identity. Sampler name+binding tuple is not an intrinsic homogeneous pair, requires one record alongside existing buffer/texture reflection records.
findings_dispositions: Remove generic redundant view_format, keep selected alternate native fact record and original request cause payload.
Name sampler role record; do not introduce closed enum for open shader names or arbitrary native indices.
D780 checked owner integration required; do not flatten population/count types or add raw-axis compatibility overload.
lenses.connected_repair: One coherent distinction per actual mix-up; remove useless duplicate field and preserve meaningful native/source/byte/shape distinctions.
lenses.acceptance: Every added distinction prevents a source-backed mistake; no redundant format authority, over-broad validator, unsupported bound or parallel owner.

repair_plan.S1: Use existing ComputePassError missing/wrong Buffer variants, extend ComputeBindingKind Uniform and one UnsupportedUniform payload variant; strict fast packing behavior unchanged.
repair_plan.S2: One coherent reflection admission/descriptor repair: reject multiple uniform variables in samegroup with typed Pipeline error before overwrite/nativecreation; represent nonstruct supported scalar/vector/squarefloatmatrix via variable name; reject unsupported uniform nested/array/signed/wide/nonsquare shapes before silentpacking. Preserve comparison and multisampled flags, storage ReadOnly/WriteOnly/ReadWrite/Atomic access. Derive floatfilterability from actual Naga entrypoint sampling_set, not unconditionaltrue. Reject external textures and resource binding arrays explicitly because PassParameters cannot represent them. Reuse Naga validation source causes. Preserve all previously working shaders and staticmissing-value/strictfast behaviors.
repair_plan.S3: UniformArenaError equivalent thiserror::Error derive using existing compute dependency, exactmessages/no source semantics.
repair_plan.S4: Correct uniformmoduleintro and fastdynamicbinding prose; Kernel/module/field/cache docs assigned780.
repair_plan.dependencies: D780 producer/cache/source contracts and D774 remaining receiving families/M06 need exactassigned implementation/source revisions; do not push/CI or clear untilresolved.
repair_plan.S2_entrypoint_policy: Pipeline reflection currently retains one layout shared by every cached entry-point name. Derive float filterability as the union of Naga sampling_set image uses across compute entry points, so every native pipeline admitted against that shared layout retains required filtering. A module whose image is load-only across all compute entries no longer acquires false filterability. Do not claim entry-point-specialized resource layouts or add a parallel per-entrypoint reflection API.
repair_plan.S2_unused_resources: Use Naga entry-point resource usage, matching pinned wgpu-core validation.rs1068-1083. Retained shared compute layout reflects resources used by any compute entry point; unused globals do not require parameters or reject an otherwise working entry point for unsupported unrelated declarations. This is intentional removal of an unnecessary unused-binding admission, preserving actual executed shader behavior and supplied valid values. Uniform global usage retains whole block members/padding and existing strict fast packing for those blocks. No compatibility fallback or ignore-error path.

repair_paths_added.responsibility: Checked supported uniform shape/value admission into existing UniformMember; rejects unrepresentable aggregate before mutation.
Faithful native texture class/access/sample/filterability descriptor reflection; unsupportedresource errors before nativecreation.

uniform_shape_extension_before_repair.status: all13 source discovery complete before expected-value shape repair; not clearance
evidence: shader.rs UniformMember retains name/offset/size but no scalar/vector/matrix role
reflection/uniforms.rs is sole producer (all struct literals searched)
bind_group/uniforms.rs writes based only on supplied PassParameter; wrong Mat4 can overwrite neighboring fields inside a sufficiently large block
kernel/fast/uniforms.rs similarly packs supported parameter without comparing declared native value role
uniform_shape_extension_before_repair.contracts: Retain supported declared shape in canonical shader-owned UniformValueShape. Static missing or wrong-value-kind keeps zero-default policy per field; fast missing/unsupported remains strict typed rejection. Correctly typed successful values retain bytes/order/stride. Mismatched numeric/vector/matrix values are no longer interpreted as another declared type or allowed to overwrite a neighbor.

lenses.producer-propagation: Naga TypeInner -> UniformValueShape retained with UniformMember -> static and fast writers, no primitive reconstruction.
lenses.existing-type-owners: No existing expected-uniform-shape owner; PassParameter represents supplied value, not declared shape. Own once next to UniformMember in shader.
lenses.admission-contracts: Only f32/u32 scalar, f32 vector2/3/4 and squaref32matrix2/3/4 admitted; reject other native shapes typed before interface mutation. All literal producers searched, no serializer bypass.
lenses.invariant-operations: Shape matching before writing prevents scalar/member overwrite; existing checked byte ranges and native offsets retained.
lenses.aggregate-states: name/offset/span/expected shape admitted atomically from same Naga member and passed unchanged to both writers.
lenses.type-ownership: Single shader owner exported to pipeline and compute consumers, no packing-local duplicate enum.
lenses.redundant-authority: Expected shape not derivable from span alone (f32/u32 samewidth, vec4/mat2 same16bytes); retained distinction necessary, not competing span authority.
lenses.behavior-preservation: Previously correctly typed supported values unchanged. Static missing/wrong-role fields stayzero; fast wrongrole nowtypedunsupported. No fixture/oracle changes.
lenses.enum-shapes: Closed payload-free shape enum matches actual PassParameter/math roles; no numeric-tagplusconditionalfields. Mat4 accepts Transform nativeencoding.
lenses.derivability: Clone/Copy/Debug/PartialEq/Eq derives; explicit accepts predicate encodes value-role semantics, not boilerplate.
lenses.type-granularity: Eight meaningful supported shape roles prevent concrete wrongbit/neighbor corruption; unsupportedtype details remain separate PipelineError.
lenses.magic-strings: Open membername remainsshaderidentifier; no texttype tags or prosebranching.
lenses.magic-numbers: Native f32/u32 width and vector/matrix dimensions map to semantic shape at Naga boundary; byteoffsets/packing stillactualABI.

uniform_shape_extension_before_repair.acceptance: Both writers verify declared shape before writing, no wrongkind clobber; all admitted producers/consumers carry one owner, no new tests/cases/helpers/assertions.

findings.title: Fallible texture read accepts host types that panic at the final byte cast
findings.scenario: An initialized 1x1 R8Unorm texture/view read::<u32> yields one packed byte then bytemuck::cast_slice panics with slop; nonempty read::<()> also fails. Vec<u8> allocation does not contractually satisfy arbitrary T alignment even when byte count divides T.
findings.contract: A Result<Vec<T>> read should reject unsupported host layout without panic and copy bytes into an aligned, initialized Vec<T>.
findings.connected_repair: Reuse the existing canonical buffer Readback<T> host admission/copy owner; make its required crate scope available, without duplicating typed allocation/initialization logic. Preserve View empty-first before host admission.
acceptance: Nonempty ZST/partial elements return existing concrete host-layout error before native work.
Aligned destination handles unaligned input bytes and preserves all original native-endian bits.
Packed output excludes every padded GPU row and preserves z-major then row-major order.

findings.title: Texture staging volume narrows through unchecked u32 arithmetic
findings.scenario: Texture3d::read computes padded_row*height*depth as u32 then casts to u64. A 1024-cubed R32Float volume has 2^32 bytes, within source dimension bounds when the provider admits the allocation; debug panics or release wraps before the native buffer limit can reject it. This does not claim any current device can allocate it. A larger custom 2D device may expose the analogous 16384-square RGBA32 case; baseline 8192 2D alone does not prove that scenario.
findings.contract: Rows, full padded staging volume, packed bytes and host addresses must be related in checked wide byte units before allocation/copy/slicing.
findings.connected_repair: One texture transfer-layout aggregate, native extent+pixel format at admission, BufferByteLength/Offset for byte semantics, checked row alignment/native-u32 and host-usize narrowing. Reuse SDK alignment constant. Check copy range against actual mapped extent; do not invent broader constructor/schema migrations.
acceptance: Checked padded and packed u64 products; checked native row and usize conversions retain actual narrowing causes.
No u32 volume/row-index multiplication before widening.
Queue upload rows stay tight, encoder copy rows stay 256-aligned; full padded allocation is permitted though SDK copy omits trailing last-row padding.

findings.title: Texture map/read progress loses concrete errors and lacks canonical request ownership
findings.scenario: Native callback Err becomes a formatted String, oneshot cancellation becomes a generic String, Poll failure is discarded; wasm erases even map detail. create_buffer and map_async immediate native validation also occur outside observe_validation; a synchronous map failure can route through the device sink before the function reports its callback error.
findings.contract: Keep actual native, BufferAsyncError, PollError and Canceled values, fail at the earliest observed boundary and clean this private request without replacing its primary error.
findings.connected_repair: Reuse canonical MappingRequest, BufferReadError, context.observe_validation and callback_progress; add only the separately owned nonblocking texture completion behavior. Own cleanup before scope result inspection, including synchronous callback. Preserve existing Buffer::read explicit-wait method.
acceptance: Ready-first callback outcome/cancellation precedes a later Poll; pending polls retain actual errors.
Texture native progress retains 1ms async cadence; no added Wait, including borrowed context; browser yields and may drive enabled non-WebGPU providers.
Successful view drops before unmap. Error/cancellation/unwind reset only owned private request; cleanup-only native scope no wait, no primary-error replacement.
No unconditional unmap on unrelated external aliases, no fake SDK map/device state query, no new global mapping lock.

findings.title: Texture upload Result boundaries miss immediate native queue validation
findings.scenario: For an initialized positive-size R32Float texture, write(&[]) reaches SDK queue source-byte bounds validation; queue errors route through its sink immediately. These functions return Ok if that handler continues, or panic under default handling, rather than returning the actual available native cause. The same boundary exists on image/cube uploads after packing.
findings.contract: Owned native validation policy must observe queue write at the actual immediate boundary, after conversion/layout; do not rely on a later submit scope.
findings.connected_repair: Wrap only queue.write_texture in context.observe_validation after fallible conversion and checked tight layout; existing context device/queue precondition and borrowed/browser handler policy remain. All five source call sites must be migrated together.
acceptance: Actual available native cause enters the owning error chain; no message flattening.
No new GPU completion wait or waiting ValidationScope for queue writes.
Do not impose 256-byte alignment on queue writes, require exact source size when SDK accepts trailing data, or change existing colour/packing behavior.
Cube per-face upload does not promise atomic rollback of already queued earlier faces.

findings.title: Image float decoding relies on byte-vector alignment
findings.scenario: read_image reads Vec<u8> then casts it to &[f32] for Rgba32Float/R32Float. This reintroduces an alignment requirement that the byte vector contract does not guarantee after TR1 is fixed.
findings.contract: Image decoding must preserve native-endian float values without borrowing f32 from an alignment-one allocation.
findings.connected_repair: Use exact four-byte chunks and f32::from_ne_bytes, preserving clamp/round/greyscale/alpha and format decisions. This is not a new Image schema or colour-policy rewrite.
acceptance: Complete float byte chunks decode in existing native endian order; successful numerical operations/formats unchanged.
No mapped view held across host allocation and no new float alignment assumption.

Do not wait on GPU in cleanup, do not leave a native ErrorScopeGuard across await, and do not infer arbitrary alias map ownership.

scheduling: Texture reads currently use ready-first native try_recv then nonblocking Poll plus 1ms async sleep; preserve cadence with canonical polling completion entry.
Canonical Buffer::read complete() explicitly Waits; do not replace texture behavior by calling it without a consciously changed contract.
Browser WebGPU progresses automatically; canonical browser callback also drives non-WebGPU providers and yields zero timer turns.
Borrowed false/browser perform no new validation wait or verdict scope; available native poll/map errors remain results.
Submission finish and queue boundaries remain canonical immediate no-wait context.submit.
Native Poll(Poll) may return no timeout on some providers; do not infer an observed runtime failure. Still retain every actual Result error rather than discard.
publication: Readback has no shared result cache; errors return no successful partially initialized Vec<T>.
Image upload creates private candidate before write; observe immediate write before returning it. Cube multiple uploads are not rollback-atomic.
Raw render/cube paths continue existing producer/submission semantics; no texture readback success certifies earlier ignored producing error, later writes or global GPU health.

pre_repair_findings_reconciled.proof: TextureReadSource::read admits canonical Readback<T> before native allocation and keeps its aligned Vec<T> reservation. packed_storage reserves tight byte capacity separately before mapping. Readback::copy_from performs initialized byte copy into Vec<T>; no u8-to-T borrowed cast remains. ZST/partial returns BufferReadError. View public empty guard remains before host admission, so empty View<()> still returns empty.

TextureTransferLayout sealed extent, row, packed byte aggregate: row=u64(width)*u64(pixel_size), safe because the only factors are u32 and maximum 16. NativeRow try_from retains actual TryFromIntError. Checked volume uses u64 height/depth. TextureStagingLayout checks positive transfer bytes, padded pitch and its native u32 field, complete volume and actual device max_buffer_size. packed_storage narrows full padded and packed extents to usize before GPU allocation. unpack gets complete padded extent and checks native row/pitch usize; positive pitch and exact height*depth rows follow sealed construction. No u32 row/volume/index products remain.

Staging create immediate observe maps BufferReadError::Native; canonical context.submit keeps original ComputePassError::Native Arc cause for finish/submit. MappingExtent bounds actual staging.size and aligned nonzero range; MappingRequest installs private release obligation inside immediate operation before scope result. Native texture code exclusively uses ready-first poll_complete and 1ms sleep; cfg browser uses canonical complete browser branch. Buffer::read explicit native Wait body unchanged. unpacked view is dropped before error propagation/unmap. Drop cleanup preserves first error and resets own request with cleanup-only native scope, no completion wait. Actual Mapping/Poll/Channel/Native error owners and source chains remain.

All five callers now use TextureTransferLayout::write: 2d write/create_from_image,3d write,cube create_from_images/set_side_image. Native descriptor rows tight and admitted u32, same extent/origin/mip/aspect preserved. Immediate observe_validation only wraps actual queue.write_texture, direct available wgpu error enters anyhow; no wait or length-equality precheck, so supported trailing bytes preserved. Conversion/layout finish before queue operation. Cube sequential upload remains non-atomic, documented.

Rgba32Float/R32Float read_image decode complete size_of<f32>() chunks with f32::from_ne_bytes, then exact existing narrow/grey/alpha transforms. Constructors/readback guarantee whole native pixel bytes for these formats, so no new partial float path. Image fallback expected byte count uses checked layout rather than u32 product. Cube float conversion reserves from actual input byte count, which bounds complete four-channel group output, preserving transfer operations and channel order; no schema mutation.

current_contracts.proof: For a nonempty staging record, width, height, depth and pixel_size are positive; row>0, padded pitch>=row, full padded volume is exactly pitch*height*depth. The sum of unpacked rows is exactly packed row*height*depth, so reserved packed capacity covers every extend without allocation while mapped. Full mapped range matches staging.bytes and is mapping-aligned via 256-byte pitch. Last-row allocation padding is allowed by SDK and omitted from output.

Public View retains zero-first; 2d/3d allocate-presence then ensure_device before layout/T. Reads do not require cache, and clear_native_texture does not become readable via cached view. Face reads retain origin.z layer and one-layer extent. Source record zero case is checked and cannot cause zero-length native slice.

On request scope rejection, returned request value is dropped and cleanup resets API requested context; native Idle NotMapped is cleanup-only. source_reasoning: The five observation sites drain the correct context-owned native scope before returning their candidate or recording success. Cached dispatch drops the native pass, resolves the original body result against observation and increments its count only after both succeed. The resolver retains the earlier body error as source and simultaneous typed secondary observation. CompiledLayout observes native layout/pipeline creation before publication. FastPath prepares and packs before its scope, then observes bind-group creation and writes before returning Prepared.

UniformArena publishes a new chunk and resets its used cursor only after successful observation. Already-consumed existing slots and encoded commands are not rolled back after later failure. Copy checks both typed logical ends, retains zero-extent native admission and does not increment the dispatch count. Actual Device-axis admission precedes preparation and writes. Borrowed/browser policy gains no blocking wait. after_submit callbacks run in registration order only after context.submit returns Ok; this is not GPU completion.

Transient Progress retains actual poll and optional native causes, is not published as a successful Kernel or native pipeline cache admission, and removes an older same-entry DeviceHandled entry. Native-only rejection caching is unchanged. Progress creates no new Compiled transition; a previous Compiled marker may remain, with compiled() re-entering absent cache admission before returning a handle. Native-only conversions retain ordinary direct native identity. No recovery of prior device-handled errors is claimed.

The F05/F23 ledger explicitly accepts provided-variant whole-block skip behavior. A used 16-byte vec4 block supplied a 64-byte Mat4 skips that write and may successfully remain zero, in both baseline and current packers. Earlier overlapping writes remain intact. This is settled preservation, not a pending repair or fast/static mismatch. Missing/unsupported fast variants still fail; static inner Mat3 ranges can fail after their outer span fits. Fast offsets remain bounded by sealed Naga metadata and the 256-byte fast cap. Broad prose must not imply all oversized supported writes fail.

Peer provenance has three byte-exact files and four source-equivalent formatting differences: cfg import order, one signature wrap, one closure wrap and a trailing newline. Both peer and committed Root hashes are recorded. All seven committed files are not described as byte-exact peer source.
